name: video-perception
description: Give agents practiced, local-first video perception: capability discovery, coarse-to-fine evidence gathering, and decentralized provider and knowledge-pack authoring.

interface.shortDescription: Give agents a practiced, local-first way to understand video
interface.longDescription: Discover what a machine already provides, apply curated video-reading techniques, connect user-owned models and APIs, and return queryable observations with provenance.
defaultPrompt: Tell me what happens in this video
Find the important moments in this video using only local capabilities
Connect my existing vision model as a video provider
Turn this video-reading method into a reusable perception pack
